notes: KNOWN BUG (KNOWLEDGE/2026-11-18/215, fault F13; BACKLOG 'Target recheck gap'). Fails on main 8d85e0a7; passes once a spell's own 'as you cast it' restriction on its targets is read when the targets are chosen (CR 601.2c) and not again at resolution (CR 608.2b). Enthralling Hold (verified, M21): 'Enchant creature. You can't choose an untapped creature as this spell's target as you cast it. You control enchanted creature.' Its ruling of 2020-06-23: 'If the creature becomes untapped before the spell resolves, it still resolves.' Seat 0 casts it on seat 1's tapped Ox. In response seat 1 casts Revitalize; its draw triggers seat 1's Tolarian Kraken (verified, M21), which pays {1} ('fire') and untaps the Ox ('ox', 'fire', '1'). The Hold still resolves: seat 0 controls the Ox. On main the resolution re-reads the restriction, finds the Ox untapped, and the Hold does not resolve: WEAKER than printed, reachable in the M21 deal pool with three verified cards.
